हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A billionaire CEO disguises himself as a humble tea seller to stay close to the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When she runs away from a forced marriage, fate brings them into a contract marriage built on secrets and unexpected romance. But as truth and family conflicts surface, he must decide whether to reveal who he really is or risk losing her forever.
